verdict.rationale: Mirrors lets users preview routing conditions against stored traces before activation, reviewing matches, misses, and unexpected matches without changing live agent behavior. It also supports holdout comparisons and rollback, which give a safety net. This is pre-activation dry-run testing on recorded data, not a dedicated sandbox or staging environment isolated from production. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging environment or test mode, isolation from production data (previews use real stored traces), documentation of test credentials or environments, and hands-on corroboration.
